Summary: As a developer, I want separated frontend/backend folders so the code stays modular and maintainable.
Description: Acceptance criteria: Frontend (React) and backend (Express) are in separate folders with their own package.json and env files.

Summary: As a developer, I want all secrets in environment variables so API keys are never exposed.
Description: Acceptance criteria: No secrets in code; .env.example provided; dotenv loads config on the server only.

Summary: As a developer, I want a Dockerfile so the app can run on any cloud host.
Description: Acceptance criteria: Container builds the frontend and runs API + UI from one process; health check passes.

Summary: As a developer, I want a normalized MySQL schema for all entities so data is consistent.
Description: Acceptance criteria: Tables: users, customer_profiles, products, cart, orders, order_items, password_reset_tokens with FKs and indexes.

Summary: As a developer, I want realistic seed data so the app demos well.
Description: Acceptance criteria: 24 products across 6 categories, demo customer + admin accounts, sample orders seeded.

Summary: As a developer, I want the database to auto-create and seed on first boot so setup is one command.
Description: Acceptance criteria: initDb creates DB, applies schema, seeds only when empty; idempotent.

Summary: As a customer, I want to register so I can create my own account.
Description: Acceptance criteria: Name/email/password validated; duplicate email rejected with 409; password bcrypt-hashed.

Summary: As a customer, I want to log in and log out so my data stays private.
Description: Acceptance criteria: Login returns JWT; token sent as Bearer; logout clears token; protected routes return 401 without it.

Summary: As a customer, I want to reset my password so I can recover access.
Description: Acceptance criteria: Single-use reset token, hashed in DB, expires in 1 hour; demo returns the link in dev.

Summary: As an admin, I want role-based access so only I can manage the shop.
Description: Acceptance criteria: Admin routes require role=admin; customers get 403 on /api/admin.

Summary: As a customer, I want to edit my name and email so my details stay current.
Description: Acceptance criteria: PUT /api/profile updates account; duplicate email rejected.

Summary: As a customer, I want to save measurements and style preferences so the AI stylist can use them.
Description: Acceptance criteria: Height, JSON measurements, preferred style/color/fit saved to customer_profiles.

Summary: As a customer, I want to change my password so my account stays secure.
Description: Acceptance criteria: Current password verified before setting new one.

Summary: As a customer, I want to browse products by category so I can find what I need.
Description: Acceptance criteria: GET /api/products supports category filter, pagination, in-stock flag.

Summary: As a customer, I want to search and filter by color, size, and price so I can narrow my choices.
Description: Acceptance criteria: Search q, color, size (JSON_CONTAINS), min/max price, sort options.

Summary: As a customer, I want a product detail page with related items so I can decide.
Description: Acceptance criteria: GET /api/products/:id returns product + 4 related items from same category.

Summary: As an admin, I want to add, edit, and delete products so the catalog stays current.
Description: Acceptance criteria: Admin CRUD with image upload validated by MIME type and 5MB size.

Summary: As a customer, I want AI recommendations from occasion, style, color, fit, size, and measurements so I find the perfect outfit.
Description: Acceptance criteria: POST /api/stylist/recommend returns up to 6 real products with reasons.

Summary: As a customer, I want to upload a photo so the stylist can sense tones I like.
Description: Acceptance criteria: Photo validated (≤5MB, image types); passed to Gemini vision when a key is set.

Summary: As a customer, I want recommendations that never judge my body so I feel respected.
Description: Acceptance criteria: System prompt and local engine only discuss clothing, fit, color, occasion; no body comments.

Summary: As a developer, I want a built-in fallback engine so the app works without API keys.
Description: Acceptance criteria: Local rule-based scorer ranks catalog; provider label shown in UI.

Summary: As a customer, I want to add items to my cart so I can purchase them later.
Description: Acceptance criteria: Add merges quantity; stock limits enforced server-side.

Summary: As a customer, I want to update or remove cart items so I control my order.
Description: Acceptance criteria: PATCH quantity (0 removes), DELETE line; totals and badge update.

Summary: As a customer, I want to check out with shipping details and a payment method so I can place an order.
Description: Acceptance criteria: Shipping validated; COD/GCash/Card; order created in transaction; stock decremented; cart cleared.

Summary: As a customer, I want my order history so I can track purchases.
Description: Acceptance criteria: GET /api/orders lists my orders with status filters.

Summary: As a customer, I want order details and the ability to cancel pending orders.
Description: Acceptance criteria: Detail view with status timeline; cancel only when Pending; restocks items.

Summary: As an admin, I want a dashboard with sales statistics so I can monitor the shop.
Description: Acceptance criteria: Revenue, order counts, customers, low-stock, 14-day revenue chart, top products.

Summary: As an admin, I want to manage inventory so stock levels are accurate.
Description: Acceptance criteria: Set stock or apply delta; low-stock indicators; only admins can access.

Summary: As an admin, I want to manage orders and customers so I can fulfil and serve them.
Description: Acceptance criteria: Update order status through Pending→…→Delivered; customer list with total spend.

Summary: As a user, I want the app deployed to the cloud so I can access it from anywhere without my laptop.
Description: Acceptance criteria: Docker deploy on Back4App; health endpoint ok; connected to TiDB cloud DB.

Summary: As a user, I want a mobile-friendly experience so I can use the app on my phone.
Description: Acceptance criteria: PWA installable; React Native app in mobile/ builds via Expo.
